info.description: Generated from the server Joi validators (srv/validators). Request bodies are authoritative; response `data` shapes are typed in the TypeScript API namespace and left open here. All RPC methods are POST with the {status,data|error} envelope; RPC errors ride HTTP 200. Non-REST validator domains not covered here: BaseArticle, Mediasoup, Socket (see docs/api/socket-events.md and docs/api/protoo-methods.md).
